title: 第261章 欲成大事欲谋全局第260章 精血之秘
content_zh:
一瞬的恍惚之后，陈阳便是立马回过神来，张口道：“此人所修生杀之术不是仙道之法，而是一门神通！他在上界炼化了一尊神灵！”
此言一出，在场的沧澜神众皆是心头微怔，再看向这件仙宝之时，便都是流露出了惋惜与伤怀之色。
方才他们听到的那句话语声，便是这位神道生灵，在被那海阁真君彻底炼化之前的最后一份遗言。
这位神道生灵与他们一样，皆是在神道倾覆的大劫之中苟存下了一条性命，并于灵元界中幸运的寻到了一处栖身之所，往后便始终躲在那方隐秘空间之内生息苦熬，坚信着当年神君承诺的复兴之日会到来。
但同为古时遗留下来的神道生灵，这位神灵的好运，却是没能一直延续下去。
他没有如符因、武化、枯运几位同道一般，等到一位归来的神君，而是在万载的坚守过后，遇到了一名只存贪婪与掠夺之念的踏虚境仙修。
经过了万年的煎熬，承受着恶力的侵蚀与道行的衰减，这位神灵的实力早已大不如前。
但在与海阁真君的斗法中，他还是拼命作了抵抗，直至对方以五行仙法将其意识完全抹除才不再挣扎，也是在意识尚存的最后一刻，他将这句遗言封存进了所修神通之中。
如果海阁真君不曾因为觊觎沧澜至宝而降下术法，陈阳与一众沧澜神灵也不可能在此刻听到这份满是心酸与不甘的话语。
这是他们第一次接触到沧澜洲之外的神灵信息，只是没想到，第一次听到外界神灵的声音，竟是以这种方式...
“君上，霜华如今修行不足，没法再进一步深入了。”
这时候，霜华神尊也缓缓收起了神力，与陈阳说道：“君上，由此番探查可知，这位...神灵同道生前的修为不弱，已是达到晋升下位神的要求，所修神术乃是过去一方生灭道大神正统，其名为‘盈虚’，是一门可以汲取他人生机供养自身的下位神术。”
“但因不得大道支撑，这位同道始终无法破境，难以真正修成此术，后来遇上那名修为深厚的海阁仙修，亦是难以与之抗衡，最终只得不甘陨落。”
通过霜降神术的探查，霜华神尊道出了更多关于这位已故神灵的信息。
当听得对方已经拥有了晋升的资格，却因大道不存而遗憾殒命，场间众神无不在心间为其感到惋惜与慨叹。
彼此相视之下，他们也是联想到了自身。
当年若是不曾遇到神君大人，他们的结局，恐怕也只有消亡一途，如今能够站在沧澜神众的列次上，皆是仰仗这位神君大人的出手搭救。
念及此处，他们的视线便都不约而同的落在了陈阳的石体本尊之上，心中感怀之念更甚。
众神的簇拥与注视之下，陈阳听过霜华的讲述之后，停留在原地久久不语。
今日这份神灵遗言，再一次让他感受到了重塑神道之路的任重道远。

关于造化本源的消息，已经在上界之中广为流传，那些从古修时期艰难存活下来的神道生灵们，也已然成为了各方仙道势力眼中的香饽饽，是能够凭空助长道法、增进修为的造化至宝。
在这种大背景之下，相较于沧澜洲之内，这些流离于外界的神道生灵们的处境便都是岌岌可危。
“大任在身，时不我待。”
陈阳在心中默默自语，心中对于修为精进的渴求再一次达到了顶峰，恨不得现在就凭借仙躯破开天幕登天而上。
不说其他几方大域，只论灵元东域之中，能够将这些神道生灵们从危局中解救出来的，也就只有他这位沧澜神君了。
content_en:
After a moment of trance, Chen Yang immediately came back to his senses and opened his mouth and said: "The art of life and death that this person has cultivated is not an immortal method, but a magical power! He refined a god in the upper world!"
As soon as these words came out, all the Canglan gods present were slightly startled, and when they looked at this fairy treasure, they all showed regret and sadness.
The words they heard just now were the last words of this Shinto creature before he was completely refined by the True Lord Haige.
Like them, this Shinto creature managed to survive the catastrophe of the Shinto overthrow, and was lucky enough to find a shelter in the Lingyuan world. From then on, he always hid in that secret space to live and suffer, firmly believing that the day of revival promised by the God Lord would come.
But as a Shinto creature left over from ancient times, this god's good luck could not continue forever.
He did not wait for a returning divine king like Fu Yin, Wu Hua, and Ku Yun. Instead, after tens of thousands of years of perseverance, he met a Tao Void Realm immortal cultivator who only had greed and plunder.
After tens of thousands of years of suffering, suffering from the erosion of evil forces and the decline of Taoism, the strength of this god has long been reduced to what it once was.
However, in the battle with True Lord Haige, he still put up a desperate resistance. He stopped struggling until the other party used the Five Elements Immortal Technique to completely erase his consciousness. It was also at the last moment when his consciousness was still alive that he sealed these last words into the magical power he had cultivated.
If True Lord Haige had not cast down his spells because he coveted the Canglan treasure, Chen Yang and the Canglan gods would not have heard these words full of sadness and unwillingness at this moment.
This is the first time they have come into contact with information from gods outside Canglan Continent, but they did not expect that the first time they heard the voice of outside gods would be in this way...
"Your Majesty, Shuanghua has not practiced enough now and cannot go any further."
At this time, Lord Shuanghua also slowly put away his divine power, and said to Chen Yang: "Your Majesty, from this investigation, it can be seen that this... fellow god's cultivation during his lifetime was not weak, and he has met the requirements for promotion to a lower god. The divine technique he practiced is the orthodox one of the great gods of life and death in the past. Its name is 'Yingxu', which is a lower divine technique that can absorb the vitality of others to support itself."
"But without the support of the great avenue, this fellow Taoist was still unable to break through the realm and find it difficult to truly cultivate this technique. Later, when he met the Haige Immortal Cultivator with profound cultivation, it was difficult to compete with him, and he had to accept his death."
Through the exploration of the Frost Descent Technique, Lord Shuanghua revealed more information about the deceased god.
When they heard that the other party was already qualified for promotion, but unfortunately died because of the lack of Dao, all the gods present felt sorry and lamented for him.
As they looked at each other, they also thought of themselves.
If they had not met the Lord God back then, their fate would have been to perish. Now they are able to stand in the ranks of the Canglan Gods because of the rescue of the Lord God.
Thinking of this, their eyes all fell on Chen Yang's stone body, and they felt even more nostalgic in their hearts.
Surrounded and watched by the gods, Chen Yang stayed where he was for a long time without saying a word after listening to Shuanghua's story.
Today's last words from the gods once again made him feel that there was a long way to go to reshape Shinto.
News about the origin of creation has been widely circulated in the upper world. Those Shinto creatures who have survived the ancient cultivation period have become the favorites of all the immortal forces. They are the treasures of creation that can promote Taoism and enhance cultivation out of thin air.
Against this background, compared to those within Canglan Continent, the situation of these Shinto beings living outside is more precarious.
"We have great responsibilities, but time waits for us not."
Chen Yang silently muttered to himself in his heart, his desire for improvement in cultivation reached its peak once again, and he wished he could do it nowWith his immortal body, he broke through the sky and ascended to the sky.
Not to mention the other major regions, just in the Lingyuan Eastern Region, the only one who can rescue these Shinto creatures from the crisis is he, the Canglan Divine Lord.
